quotes.text: For selected-rebase parent anchors, suppress a duplicate only when stable identity (`TB-Tools-Id`/Differential Revision) and nonempty `git patch-id --stable` both match; rebased hashes alone do not establish a distinct patch. `getGraphCommitPatchId()` is the existing comparison primitive.
